title: AWS S3 bucket TLS enforcement
description: Per-bucket record of whether the bucket policy denies requests not sent over TLS, captured by the AWS connector from GetBucketPolicy (#2993). The record's result is the verdict. policy_present and denies_insecure_transport are present only when the connector read the policy or found the bucket has none; an unread bucket omits both and carries reason.

denies_insecure_transport.description: True when the policy has Deny statements for every principal and every S3 action, on the bucket and its objects, conditioned only on Bool aws:SecureTransport false. False when the policy is absent or has no such statements.

reason.description: Why the result is inconclusive: the AWS error from the region or policy lookup, or why the policy could not be parsed.
